mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the month-over-month change) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced discount rates and increased equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the federal funds rate declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the CPI index exceeds 2.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns due to heightened inflation expectations and central bank policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises (month-over-month) and housing starts decline (month-over-month), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns due to conjoined labor market deterioration and weak housing demand.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and HOUST falls > 100 units
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and HOUST falls > 100 units (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns due to reduced liquidity and elevated risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (measured as the month-over-month change) is associated with negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to weakening consumer demand and reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when housing starts decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (measured as the month-over-month change) is associated with negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced manufacturing output and lower corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when industrial production declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% (from the previous month), the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns due to heightened economic uncertainty and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit demand (RSAFS) declines and industrial production (INDPRO) declines, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns due to dual shocks to credit demand and supply conditions.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 100 million and INDPRO falls > 1 point
regime_hint: dual demand and supply shock regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls > 100 million and INDPRO falls > 1 point (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
